# Solent Marine Outboards UK

> UK outboard motor dealership and marine rigging specialist supplying Yamaha, Suzuki, Honda, Mercury and Tohatsu petrol outboards alongside ePropulsion, Torqeedo, TEMO, Haswing, Minn Kota and Blade Electric propulsion, with certified Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) and nationwide UK delivery.

## Overview
- **Brand:** Solent Marine Outboards UK
- **Headquarters:** Cowes Yacht Haven, High Street, Cowes, Isle of Wight, PO31 7BD, United Kingdom
- **Contact:** sales@solentmarineoutboards.co.uk | +44 1983 294400 | WhatsApp: +44 7700 900888
- **Minimum Order:** £50.00
- **Free UK Delivery:** On all orders over £500.00 (includes pallet tail-lift for outboard motors)
- **Warranty:** Official UK manufacturer warranty (up to 5 years on Yamaha, Suzuki, Honda, Mercury and Tohatsu)
- **Payment Methods:** UK Bank Transfer (BACS/Faster Payments), Visa, Mastercard, Marine Proforma Invoice, Marine Hire Purchase Finance (12-60 months)

## Product Categories
- [Portable Outboards (2.5HP - 6HP)](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/portable/): Lightweight petrol auxiliary and tender engines from £711.
- [Mid-Range Outboards (8HP - 40HP)](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/mid-range/): Twin-cylinder and EFI motors for RIBs and dayboats from £1,036.
- [High-Power Outboards (50HP - 400HP+)](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/high-horsepower/): High-performance multi-cylinder marine engines from £5,200.
- [Electric & Eco Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/electric/): Zero-emission propulsion and trolling motors from ePropulsion, Torqeedo, TEMO, Haswing, Minn Kota and Blade Electric from £107.
- [Genuine Oils, Rigging & Spares](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/parts/): Engine oils, batteries, chargers, service kits and rigging hardware from £4.50.

## Shop by Brand
- [Yamaha Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/yamaha/): Authorized Yamaha Marine dealer since 2016.
- [Mercury Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/mercury/): 3.5HP FourStroke portables to the 400HP Verado V10.
- [Honda Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/honda/): BF2.3 through to the BF100 XRU.
- [Suzuki Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/suzuki/): Authorized Suzuki Outboards UK dealer since 2016.
- [Tohatsu Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/tohatsu/): Class-leading power-to-weight ratios.
- [ePropulsion Electric Outboards](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/epropulsion/): Electric propulsion and pod drives.

## Guides & Advice
- [Outboard Motor Guides](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/blog/): Sizing guides, maintenance how-tos, and buying advice, including a horsepower sizing pillar guide and a Mercury/Yamaha serial-number identification guide.

## Customer Services & Tools
- [Full Outboard Stock Directory](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shop/): Search and filter the full catalog by brand, category, engine type and price; includes an on-page side-by-side specification comparison tray for up to 3 engines.
- [Technical FAQ & Shaft Guide](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/faq/): Transom height measurements, PDI inspection information, and maintenance basics.
- [UK Shipping & Pallet Dispatch Policy](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/shipping/): Details on courier and tail-lift freight delivery across the UK mainland and islands, and regular delivery across the Solent (Hamble, Hythe, Lymington, Portsmouth, Swanwick).
- [Contact Rigging Engineers](https://solentmarineoutboards.co.uk/contact/): Get in touch with our certified engineers in Cowes.

Each product page includes a monthly marine finance estimate tool inline — there is no separate finance page.
